name: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd
about: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd, incorporated in 1958, is part of the Pune-based Kirloskar group. The Co. is engaged in the business of Compression & Transmission segments. It also undertakes O&M services for Compression Packages and has also entered logistic services by operating RoadRailer trains for end to end transportation of goods. It serves a variety of sectors like Oil & Gas, Steel, Cement, Food & Beverages, Railways, Marine and other industries. [1] [2]
keyPoints:
Market Share
The Co. is market leader in CNG systems and oil and gas refrigeration in India, having a market share of over 60% in both business segments. It is the world's largest manufacturer of industrial gas compressors. [1] The Co. has a 70% market share in Indian ammonia refrigeration compressor segment. [2]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 31.8% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 31.7%
